The court will likely deny the injunction. The covenant restricts what structures may be built, not how an existing dwelling is later used, and restrictions are strictly construed against restriction. The shared note is inaccurate: under the common-scheme doctrine, plat restrictions are generally enforceable by other lot owners without each owner signing the covenant. The main risk is that a court reads "dwelling purposes" as a general residential-use limit and enjoins the dental office.

CONFIDENCE: 60
